notes: Original volumetric (Hiden HTP-1) H2 excess and total-stored isotherms at 80 K, 0-100 bar, on a boron-doped corncob activated carbon before and after 1 min neutron irradiation (Fig. 4); the isotherms are shown only as a figure, with values quoted at 20 bar and in the text. Specific surface areas 3300 and 3100 m2/g by BET (N2, 77 K, P/P0 0.01-0.03). Not a review. is_retracted is false and the text carries no retraction notice. No statement that the H2 uptake values were published before: Data Availability says 'All data generated or analyzed during this study are included in the article', so duplicate_data does not apply. 80 K is not within the 76-79 K definition of 77 K (relevant to later extraction, not to eligibility).
